name: Follow-ups
author: Messages AI
description: Adds “If they don't reply” to Settings: when your message is the last one and the person doesn't answer, the app can write a short follow-up (at most 3; it waits longer if they haven't seen your message). It stays off until you turn it on there, and you can turn it off for a single person. Disable this module to hide it again; your choices are kept.
